p0Flags.gotcha: QuickBooks Online vs Desktop/Enterprise not confirmed. Two incompatible connector paths: quickbooks-online (REST/OAuth) vs quickbooks-enterprise (QBXML Web Connector or third-party bridge). FK-020 verified.
p0Flags.clientAction: Confirm which QuickBooks product is in use: QuickBooks Online (cloud), QuickBooks Pro/Premier (desktop), or QuickBooks Enterprise. If desktop/enterprise, there is no native REST API — integration approach differs completely.
p0Flags.architectNote: QBO: mule-quickbooks-online-connector (REST + OAuth 2.0). QB Desktop/Enterprise: no REST API — requires QBXML Web Connector relay or third-party bridge (DBSync, Breadwinner). FK-020: never assume QBO.

p0Flags.gotcha: Excel file storage location unconfirmed. CloudHub 2.0 local filesystem is ephemeral — cannot read local Excel files. Must be hosted on SharePoint, OneDrive, or Google Drive for MuleSoft to access.
p0Flags.clientAction: Confirm where Holly's inventory spreadsheets live: (a) Local machine — must migrate to SharePoint/OneDrive/Google Drive before integration can read them. (b) SharePoint/OneDrive — use microsoft-excel-online connector. (c) Google Drive/Sheets — use google-sheets connector.
p0Flags.architectNote: CloudHub 2.0 has no persistent local filesystem. File connector cannot reach a local path. If client insists on local file: consider SFTP drop zone on a cloud server as bridge. Prefer migration to cloud storage.

p0Flags.gotcha: ISBN mapping uses mailing state. If State/Country Picklists are enabled in Salesforce, state field values are ISO codes (e.g., 'CA'), not full names ('California'). Configurable logic table must align to whichever format Salesforce stores.
p0Flags.clientAction: Confirm whether Salesforce State/Country Picklists are enabled. Share a sample record showing the state field value format used in Opportunity mailing address.
p0Flags.architectNote: If Picklists enabled: state values are ISO 3166 subdivision codes (US-CA). If not enabled: free-text. DataWeave ISBN lookup table must match the exact format stored in SF.
